changelog:
Version 2.2.0 – Major update: skill is now platform-agnostic, supports multiple CMS targets, and refines the AI-SEO pipeline.

- Renamed skill to seo-blog-writer; broadened from Ghost-only to multi-platform (Ghost, WordPress, static-site).
- Core writing pipeline is platform-independent; publish step is pluggable via adapters.
- Added support for static-site and WordPress output, including clean HTML bundle and metadata.
- Integrated optional ai-seo-mcp audit for citation-worthiness and schema score.
- Added reference files: decorate.js and glossary-schema.md; removed legacy skill-card.md.
- Updated skill documentation to clarify new command options, adapters, preflight checks, and architecture.
